original_method: Resolve SOC PVDDCR, P-index and C semantics, enumerate all expected SOC rail-current channels and immutable raw/UI identities, collect complete value/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized SOC voltage, power/activity and VR health/temperature context, and compare each result to the owner contract without changing workload or electrical state.
manual_activity: The owner defines SOC rail/VR/P/C semantics, current scaling/limits and context tolerances; an operator verifies raw/UI identity and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: PVDDCR SOC P0..PN/C definition and physical rail/phase/domain to SDR/Redfish/UI mapping
Current unit/scale, normal range, warning/critical thresholds and sampling specification
Read-only SOC voltage, power/activity and VR health/temperature context
UI refresh/rounding tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never change SOC voltage, workload, P-state, VR settings, current limits or thresholds

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-P-index matrix containing SOC rail/VR phase/domain identity and C meaning, raw current/unit/status/threshold, SOC voltage/power/activity/VR health/thermal context and UI display.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact SOC electrical topology and passive plausibility while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and workload/voltage manipulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One current-like value cannot prove SOC/P/C semantics or cover P0..PN. Every expected mapped SOC rail channel and threshold must be reconciled.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SOC rails may supply multiple controllers or fabrics with platform-specific load behavior; CPU rail limits or generic current ranges are invalid substitutes.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently request SOC PVDDCR P-series sensor validation. Vendor rail/index/suffix semantics are missing project inputs, not contradictory source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: SOC rail/VR semantics and mapping, electrical specification and complete raw/UI/context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Separates the SOC electrical domain from CPU and IO rails and requires complete per-channel passive context before interpreting current.
independent_technical_reasoning: SOC current can reflect memory controllers, I/O fabrics or other integrated domains rather than CPU-core demand. Therefore CPU activity or package power is not a sufficient proxy, and P-index meaning must come from the board/VR topology. A valid check binds each sensor to the SOC domain and samples voltage, activity, power and VR health contemporaneously. Passive collection avoids creating a workload-dependent electrical hazard outside the original sensor-page scope.
